note: State recreation area campground along the Tamarac River a short way from Upper Red Lake at Waskish. Sites 1-14 line the river side of the loop; the northern ones (about 9E-14E) sit about 25-35 m above the bank, with first-come boat docks along the river below them. Sandy swimming beach on Upper Red Lake just west. --Claude
summary: DNR record + map + ReserveMN read: 31 drive-in (26 electric 30/50 A, 1 pull-through 17E), $24/$34, 60-ft limit, pads 23-75 ft; year-round camping; showers/flush in season, vault year-round; NO dump in park (cleared to false). Riverfront KEPT: ReserveMN marks sites 1-14 'Water Front: Yes', the northern river-side sites ~25-35 m from the bank over grass with docks. Pin is in the river ~115 m from the loop (OK by distance). Phone none -> 218-888-7310. Website 404 -> new URL.
flags: Waterfront: KEEP riverfront. ReserveMN marks sites 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5E-14E 'Water Front: Yes' (15E-31 not); DNR: 'All sites are within 100 yards of the Tamarac River' and 'many docks located in the campground area, available on a first-come, first-served basis'. Imagery (0.31 m/px) on the north loop's river side: occupied pads at about 48.17453,-94.51115 and 48.17427,-94.51102 (map positions of ~12E-14E and ~9E-11E) sit ~25-35 m from the bank over grass with scattered trees, the dock row directly below; sites 5E-8E further south are ~30 m from the bank but under trees, and 1-4 are 'Fully' shaded. All are sold by the night on ReserveMN. The water is the Tamarac River (a channel into Upper Red Lake), so riverfront rather than lakefront; the swimming beach on Upper Red Lake is a few hundred yards west.
